sql.query: SELECT id,versionNumber FROM tbl_workflow_templates WHERE id=:id AND tenantId=:tenantId AND status='published' LIMIT 1

SELECT es.id,es.statusName,es.systemCategory FROM tbl_event_statuses es WHERE es.tenantId=:tenantId AND es.isActive=1 AND (es.id=NULLIF(:eventStatusId,0) OR (:eventStatusId2=0 AND es.isDefault=1)) ORDER BY CASE WHEN es.id=NULLIF(:eventStatusId3,0) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,es.isDefault DESC,es.displayOrder,es.id LIMIT 1
UPDATE tbl_workflows SET referenceCode=CONCAT('EVT-',LPAD(id,6,'0')) WHERE id=:workflowId AND tenantId=:tenantId
SELECT referenceCode FROM tbl_workflows WHERE id=:workflowId AND tenantId=:tenantId LIMIT 1

UPDATE tbl_workflows w SET w.workflowTypeId=(SELECT t.id FROM tbl_workflow_types t WHERE t.id=NULLIF(:workflowTypeId,'') AND t.tenantId=w.tenantId AND t.isActive=1 LIMIT 1),w.locationId=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules tm INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId AND m.moduleCode='LOCATIONS' AND m.isActive=1 WHERE tm.tenantId=w.tenantId AND (tm.status='ACTIVE' OR (tm.status='TRIAL' AND (tm.trialEndsDate IS NULL OR tm.trialEndsDate>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))) AND (tm.accessStartDate IS NULL OR tm.accessStartDate<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (tm.accessEndDate IS NULL OR tm.accessEndDate>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) THEN (SELECT l.id FROM tbl_locations l WHERE l.id=NULLIF(:locationId,'') AND l.tenantId=w.tenantId LIMIT 1) ELSE NULL END,w.spaceId=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules tm INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId AND m.moduleCode='LOCATIONS' AND m.isActive=1 WHERE tm.tenantId=w.tenantId AND tm.status IN ('ACTIVE','TRIAL')) THEN (SELECT s.id FROM tbl_spaces s WHERE s.id=NULLIF(:spaceId,'') AND s.locationId=NULLIF(:locationId2,'') AND s.tenantId=w.tenantId LIMIT 1) ELSE NULL END,w.configurationId=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules tm INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId AND m.moduleCode='LOCATIONS' AND m.isActive=1 WHERE tm.tenantId=w.tenantId AND tm.status IN ('ACTIVE','TRIAL')) THEN (SELECT c.id FROM tbl_space_configurations c WHERE c.id=NULLIF(:configurationId,'') AND c.spaceId=NULLIF(:spaceId2,'') AND c.tenantId=w.tenantId LIMIT 1) ELSE NULL END WHERE w.id=:workflowId AND w.tenantId=:tenantId

UPDATE tbl_workflows w SET w.contractingEntityId=COALESCE((SELECT ce.id FROM tbl_contracting_entities ce WHERE ce.id=NULLIF(:contractingEntityId,'') AND ce.tenantId=w.tenantId AND ce.isActive=1 LIMIT 1),(SELECT ce.id FROM tbl_contracting_entities ce WHERE ce.tenantId=w.tenantId AND ce.isDefault=1 AND ce.isActive=1 LIMIT 1)) WHERE w.id=:workflowId AND w.tenantId=:tenantId

INSERT INTO tbl_workflow_stages (tenantId,workflowId,sourceTemplateStageId,stageName,description,sortOrder,status,colour,requiresProgressionApproval,allowManualOverride,approvalPrompt,allowNextStageEarlyStart) SELECT :tenantId,:workflowId,s.id,s.stageName,s.description,s.sortOrder,'not_started',s.colour,s.requiresProgressionApproval,s.allowManualOverride,s.approvalPrompt,s.allowNextStageEarlyStart FROM tbl_template_stages s WHERE s.templateId=:templateId AND s.tenantId=:tenantId2 AND s.status='active' ORDER BY s.sortOrder

UPDATE tbl_workflow_stages ws INNER JOIN tbl_template_stages ts ON ts.id=ws.sourceTemplateStageId AND ts.tenantId=ws.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_workflow_stages nextWs ON nextWs.workflowId=ws.workflowId AND nextWs.tenantId=ws.tenantId AND nextWs.sourceTemplateStageId=ts.nextStageTemplateId SET ws.nextWorkflowStageId=COALESCE(nextWs.id,(SELECT sequentialStage.id FROM tbl_workflow_stages sequentialStage WHERE sequentialStage.workflowId=ws.workflowId AND sequentialStage.tenantId=ws.tenantId AND (sequentialStage.sortOrder>ws.sortOrder OR (sequentialStage.sortOrder=ws.sortOrder AND sequentialStage.id>ws.id)) ORDER BY sequentialStage.sortOrder,sequentialStage.id LIMIT 1)) WHERE ws.workflowId=:workflowId AND ws.tenantId=:tenantId

INSERT INTO tbl_tasks (tenantId,workflowId,workflowStageId,sourceTemplateTaskId,sourceTemplateId,sourceTemplateStageId,phaseNameSnapshot,questionTextSnapshot,helpTextSnapshot,answerTypeSnapshot,requiredSnapshot,showStartDate,showDeadline,showFinishDate,allowNotes,attachmentRequirement,phaseDisplayOrder,taskDisplayOrder,answerOptionsSnapshot,taskName,description,status,priority,isRequired,responseRequired,responseType,assignedToUserId,assignedToTeamId,assignedToRoleId,dueDate,createdByUserId) SELECT :tenantId,:workflowId,ws.id,tt.id,tt.templateId,tt.templateStageId,ts.stageName,tt.taskName,tt.description,tt.answerType,tt.isRequired,tt.showStartDate,tt.showDeadline,tt.showFinishDate,tt.allowNotes,tt.attachmentRequirement,ts.sortOrder,tt.sortOrder,COALESCE((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id',o.id,'optionValue',o.optionValue,'optionLabel',o.optionLabel,'displayOrder',o.displayOrder,'isActive',o.isActive)) FROM tbl_template_task_options o WHERE o.tenantId=tt.tenantId AND o.templateTaskId=tt.id AND o.isActive=1),JSON_ARRAY()),tt.taskName,tt.description,CASE WHEN tt.answerType='task_status' AND tt.defaultAnswerValue IN ('complete') THEN 'complete' ELSE 'not_started' END,tt.priority,tt.isRequired,1,tt.answerType,CASE WHEN tt.defaultOwnerType='workflow_owner' THEN :ownerUser WHEN tt.defaultOwnerType='specific_user' THEN tt.defaultOwnerId ELSE NULL END,CASE WHEN tt.defaultOwnerType='team' THEN tt.defaultOwnerId ELSE NULL END,CASE WHEN tt.defaultOwnerType='role' THEN tt.defaultOwnerId ELSE NULL END,CASE tt.dueOffsetType WHEN 'workflow_creation_date' THEN DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE,INTERVAL (CASE WHEN tt.dueRelation='before' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)*COALESCE(tt.dueOffsetDays,0) DAY) WHEN 'workflow_start_date' THEN DATE_ADD(NULLIF(:startDate,''),INTERVAL (CASE WHEN tt.dueRelation='before' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)*COALESCE(tt.dueOffsetDays,0) DAY) WHEN 'event_target_date' THEN DATE_ADD(NULLIF(:targetDate,''),INTERVAL (CASE WHEN tt.dueRelation='before' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)*COALESCE(tt.dueOffsetDays,0) DAY) ELSE NULL END,:createdBy FROM tbl_template_tasks tt INNER JOIN tbl_template_stages ts ON ts.id=tt.templateStageId AND ts.templateId=tt.templateId AND ts.tenantId=tt.tenantId INNER JOIN tbl_workflow_stages ws ON ws.workflowId=:workflowId2 AND ws.sourceTemplateStageId=tt.templateStageId AND ws.tenantId=:tenantId2 WHERE tt.templateId=:templateId AND tt.tenantId=:tenantId3 AND tt.status='active' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tasks existing WHERE existing.tenantId=:tenantId3 AND existing.workflowId=:workflowId2 AND existing.sourceTemplateTaskId=tt.id) ORDER BY ts.sortOrder,tt.sortOrder

UPDATE tbl_tasks task INNER JOIN tbl_template_tasks templateTask ON templateTask.id=task.sourceTemplateTaskId AND templateTask.tenantId=task.tenantId INNER JOIN tbl_template_stages templateStage ON templateStage.id=templateTask.templateStageId AND templateStage.tenantId=templateTask.tenantId SET task.dueDate=CASE templateStage.defaultDueOffsetType WHEN 'workflow_creation_date' THEN DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE,INTERVAL (CASE WHEN templateStage.defaultDueRelation='after' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END)*COALESCE(templateStage.defaultDueOffsetDays,0) DAY) WHEN 'workflow_start_date' THEN DATE_ADD(NULLIF(:startDate,''),INTERVAL (CASE WHEN templateStage.defaultDueRelation='after' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END)*COALESCE(templateStage.defaultDueOffsetDays,0) DAY) WHEN 'event_target_date' THEN DATE_ADD(NULLIF(:targetDate,''),INTERVAL (CASE WHEN templateStage.defaultDueRelation='after' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END)*COALESCE(templateStage.defaultDueOffsetDays,0) DAY) ELSE NULL END WHERE task.workflowId=:workflowId AND task.tenantId=:tenantId AND task.dueDate IS NULL AND templateTask.dueOffsetType IS NULL

UPDATE tbl_tasks task SET task.dueDate=NULLIF(:startDate,'') WHERE task.id=(SELECT firstTask.id FROM (SELECT candidate.id FROM tbl_tasks candidate INNER JOIN tbl_workflow_stages stage ON stage.id=candidate.workflowStageId AND stage.tenantId=candidate.tenantId WHERE candidate.workflowId=:workflowId AND candidate.tenantId=:tenantId ORDER BY stage.sortOrder,candidate.taskDisplayOrder,candidate.id LIMIT 1) firstTask) AND task.workflowId=:workflowId2 AND task.tenantId=:tenantId2 AND task.dueDate IS NULL

UPDATE tbl_tasks task INNER JOIN tbl_template_tasks templateTask ON templateTask.id=task.sourceTemplateTaskId AND templateTask.tenantId=task.tenantId SET task.assignedToTeamId=(SELECT team.id FROM tbl_teams team WHERE team.id=templateTask.defaultTeamId AND team.tenantId=task.tenantId AND team.isActive=1 LIMIT 1),task.assignedToUserId=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_team_members member INNER JOIN tbl_user_tenants membership ON membership.id=member.userTenantId AND membership.tenantId=member.tenantId AND membership.userId=templateTask.defaultUserId AND membership.isActive=1 AND membership.membershipStatus='active' WHERE member.tenantId=task.tenantId AND member.teamId=templateTask.defaultTeamId AND member.isActive=1) THEN templateTask.defaultUserId ELSE NULL END WHERE task.workflowId=:workflowId AND task.tenantId=:tenantId

INSERT INTO tbl_task_dependencies (tenantId,workflowId,taskId,dependsOnTaskId,dependencyType) SELECT :tenantId,:workflowId,t.id,d.id,td.dependencyType FROM tbl_template_task_dependencies td INNER JOIN tbl_tasks t ON t.workflowId=:workflowId2 AND t.sourceTemplateTaskId=td.templateTaskId AND t.tenantId=:tenantId2 INNER JOIN tbl_tasks d ON d.workflowId=:workflowId3 AND d.sourceTemplateTaskId=td.dependsOnTemplateTaskId AND d.tenantId=:tenantId3 WHERE td.templateId=:templateId AND td.tenantId=:tenantId4

INSERT INTO tbl_workflow_field_values (tenantId,workflowId,templateCustomFieldId,fieldKey) SELECT :tenantId,:workflowId,f.id,f.fieldKey FROM tbl_template_custom_fields f WHERE f.templateId=:templateId AND f.tenantId=:tenantId2 AND f.status='active'

UPDATE tbl_workflows w SET w.currentStageId=(SELECT ws.id FROM tbl_workflow_stages ws WHERE ws.workflowId=w.id AND ws.tenantId=w.tenantId ORDER BY ws.sortOrder LIMIT 1),w.currentMilestoneId=(SELECT m.id FROM tbl_event_milestones m WHERE m.tenantId=w.tenantId AND m.isDefault=1 AND m.isActive=1 ORDER BY m.displayOrder,m.id LIMIT 1) WHERE w.id=:workflowId AND w.tenantId=:tenantId

INSERT INTO tbl_activity_log (tenantId,userId,workflowId,entityType,entityId,actionType,summary,afterJson,createdDate) SELECT :tenantId,:userId,:workflowId,'workflow',:entityId,'workflow.created',CONCAT(:displayName,' created ',:workflowName),JSON_OBJECT('workflowName',:workflowName2,'referenceCode',:referenceCode,'status','not_started','ownerTeamId',:ownerTeamId),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM tbl_activity_types at WHERE at.tenantId=:tenantId2 AND at.activityKey='workflow.created' AND at.isActive=1 LIMIT 1
